# Tianyu Source Media Library

This folder is the canonical media source for the website. Names use lowercase English kebab-case and semantic folders.

## Canonical folders

- `products/power-transformers/`: power transformer product imagery
- `products/distribution-transformers/`: oil-immersed distribution transformer imagery
- `products/dry-type-transformers/`: dry-type transformer imagery
- `products/combined-transformers/`: American-type / combined transformer imagery
- `products/prefabricated-substations/`: prefabricated / compact substation product imagery
- `products/switchgear/`: switchgear and circuit-breaker product imagery
- `products/special-transformers/`: special transformer imagery
- `factory/`: manufacturing, wiring, assembly and inspection photographs
- `company/`: company and campus imagery
- `applications/`: contextual/site/application imagery whose project provenance is not independently verified
- `branding/`: logos and social/OG artwork
- `decorative/`: brochure backgrounds and non-product illustrations; not preferred for website product cards
- `catalog-v3/`: curated plates derived from the supplied catalog
- `evidence/`: certificate and test-report evidence
- `evidence/sample-photo-pages/`: **full report sample-photo pages; evidence only**
- `drawings/`: engineering drawing previews
- `catalog-assets/`: generated report-page derivatives retained by document id and page number

## Hard rules

1. Files under `evidence/`, `catalog-assets/`, and `drawings/` are evidence/reference assets, not marketing product photography.
2. In particular, `evidence/sample-photo-pages/` must never be used as a product card, hero, homepage gallery, or product gallery image.
3. Prefer clean catalog imagery, workbook product originals, and independent product-library images for marketing pages.
4. `applications/` does not imply a verified Tianyu project. Do not relabel an application image as a project/case without provenance.
5. Legacy root names such as `image28.jpeg` are prohibited.

See `MEDIA_RENAME_PLAN.json` for the audited old-to-canonical path history and `MEDIA_INVENTORY.json` for the post-cleanup library inventory.
